SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   C. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   D. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   B. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
